svg.title: TOPAK I8 — Confinement_A1.tla: the successor that carries ADR-0034 finding 6. One definition changes, rung 0 becomes a row of the module, and nothing checked at rungs 1 to 3 moves: checked by TLC at rungs 0 to 3, proved by TLAPS and in Lean, and not certified
svg.desc: The successor to Confinement.tla (I7), drawn from its own text and its results file, all read at build time: the one changed definition, beside its predecessor's and with every other definition compared; every row the two runs share, compared; the same machine, properties, mutations and witnesses; every theorem and lemma; the proof run and the certified run that refused it; and the Lean re-encoding, which covers both modules. What is checked or proved here is of the module, not of the reference; the reference's recorded states are read against it through ConfinementRefinement.tla (I9). The proofs are proved and not certified.

g.text: The successor to Confinement.tla (I7), drawn from its own text and its results file, all read at build time: the one changed definition, beside its predecessor's and with every other definition compared; every row the two runs share, compared; the same machine, properties, mutations and witnesses; every theorem and lemma; the proof run and the certified run that refused it; and the Lean re-encoding, which covers both modules. What is checked or proved
here is of the module, not of the reference; the reference's recorded states are read against it through ConfinementRefinement.tla (I9). The proofs are proved and not certified.

text.tspan: Proved in Lean, of the re-encoding

svg.text: The module's header: "SUCCESSOR to Confinement.tla, which ADR-0034 cites by digest and is not edited (as Lease_A1.tla is to Lease.tla). One change: ADR-0034 finding 6. Evidence read the launch measurement at every rung but 1, so under M_HOST at rung 0 the module reached Contested, which rung 0 cannot produce: it has no evidence at all. Rungs 0 and 1 now read the profile the launcher was asked for, and only rungs 2 and 3 a measurement. Rung 0 is a row of this module, not an addendum to it

(confinement-A1-rows-2026.10.02.txt). Nothing checked at rungs 1 to 3 depends on the change. The reference's trace harness reads this module's state through ConfinementRefinement.tla: the mechanism's grant, renewal, admit and revocation, recorded by topak-core trace.rs, mapped onto lease, revoked and contested here (ADR-0045 T-0045-28, stage one)."

text.tspan: Evidence(p) == IF Declared = 1 THEN guest[p].asked ELSE guest[p].boot
Evidence(p) == IF Declared <= 1 THEN guest[p].asked ELSE guest[p].boot

svg.text: Under M_HOST at rung 0 the predecessor reached Contested, "which §2 says rung 0 cannot produce": rung 0 has no evidence at all (ADR-0034 finding 6).
The finding's correction, Evidence(p) == IF Declared <= 1 THEN guest[p].asked ELSE guest[p].boot, is this definition (compared at build time).
Every other definition of the two modules is the same, comments aside: 40 definitions compared.

g.text: the same verdict; the model's states differ (rung 0 changed)

svg.text: The 23 checks the two runs share (rung, mutation, property), compared at build time. A row name is not a check: c3 names another check in each file. At rungs 1 to 3 every verdict is the same, and every check that holds explores the same number of states, as the header says ("Nothing checked at rungs 1 to 3 depends on the change"). A counterexample's count is where TLC stopped, and the runs used different builds: Confinement-results-2026.09.28.txt, TLC2 2026.09.25.163503 (rev 8f4bc8b);
Confinement_A1-results-2026.10.02.txt, TLC Version 2.19 of 08 August 2024 (jar sha256 936a262061c91469). At rung 0 the model changed: hx0's verdict moves, and h0 explores more states.

text.tspan: The mechanism, as the module states it: a guest is appraised before it is granted, at the declared rung, and every effect is recorded with the image that was really running
A live lease, at the declared rung

svg.text: its rung, profile, epoch and the guest instance it is bound to (gen)
live, at rung 1 or above, on the archetype profile. M_PROFILE drops the profile.
re-attests: Attested renews at the rung, Unattestable lapses, Contested revokes. M_RENEWLOW renews at rung 0.
① the evidence: at rungs 0 and 1 the profile the launcher was asked for, else the launch measurement (Evidence).
M_HOST lets the host launch a rogue image or alter a guest where the rung trusts it; M_HW removes the hardware's
protection at rung 3.
② the verdict: Attested, Unattestable (rung 3 with the verifier down) or Contested, which revokes the principal
(ADR-0034 §3). M_CONTESTED treats it as Attested.
③ the grant, at the declared rung, on a fresh epoch and the same guest. M_STALE and M_UNBOUND drop those checks;
M_DOWNGRADE grants an Unattestable verdict at rung 0.

Key. ① to ③ are the appraisal and the grant; ④ the lease; ⑤ an admitted effect, recorded with what was really running, so the check compares the claim with the fact (ADR-0034 §7); ⑥ ends the round and the guest. Red marks where each mutation acts. The picture is the diagram's own drawing of the definitions below.

text.tspan: What each rung trusts the host with (the module's header)

svg.text: rung 1 launcher asserts the profile. Host trusted at launch and after.
rung 2 measured boot, appraised by the mechanism. Host may launch a rogue image; the hypervisor is trusted not to alter a running guest.
rung 3 confidential VM, independent verifier. Host trusted for nothing; the hardware turns an attempt to alter a running guest into the guest's death (the audited-row
assumption, §6).

text.tspan: What the module does not model

svg.text: The criterion conjunct: "one deployment-wide fact, taken as holding. With it false, Contained is empty and NeverContainedEffect holds trivially" (ADR-0034 §7).
A running guest altered after launch: "rungs 2 and 3 measure what was launched, and neither detects a running guest being altered" (the header; ADR-0034 §2, §5).
The successor: Confinement.tla is cited by digest and not edited, "as Lease_A1.tla is to Lease.tla" (the header).
Rung 0 is a row of this module, not an addendum to it (the header).
The reference's trace harness reads its state through ConfinementRefinement.tla (I9).

g.text: the host is untrusted where the rung trusts it. Must fail at rungs 1 and 2, and change nothing at rung 3.

an Unattestable renewal is renewed at rung 0 instead of lapsing: the frozen ADR-0031 §4 rule, which let a renewal lower the rung.

svg.text: Every row's verdict is held by the diagram (24 rows) and compared with the files both ways. "The M_HOST rows are the rung ladder, checked. The same mutation breaks containment at rungs 1 and 2 and changes nothing at rung 3" (ADR-0034 §7).
HOLDS · 746,310 states · row hx0
Finding 6, corrected: under M_HOST at rung 0 no Contested verdict is reached, because rung 0 now reads the profile asked for. In Confinement.tla the same row is a counterexample (I7).

g.text: A Contained principal acts, at rungs 1 and 3. At rung 0 it holds: no effect is counted Contained there (D-0034-4).
A rogue launch is detected at rung 3; at rungs 0 and 1 it holds.
Holds: a renewal never turns Contested.
